_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic panel, razor-sharp confident brush-and-ink line, pristine architectural perspective, crisp silhouettes, clean expressive character geometry, generous negative space. a lineup model sheet of supporting characters, front views, labeled: MARIA (practical woman in a county-issue rain shell), THE UNCLE (weathered fisherman in a rain hood beside a green-webbed lawn chair with an oxygen line), THE FRAME SHOP OWNER (woman in reading glasses on a cord at a mat cutter), THE EDITOR (young woman in a dark green coat with a tote and notebook), GULLY'S DAUGHTER at six with a marker, and two figures drawn deliberately withheld: a mother shown only as a hand setting down toast, and a father shown only as a back in a faded mill jacket. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, airbrush, neon, anime, watermark, extra fingers
